answer: To resist sybils the network builds a dynamic trellis of funding ancestry: any cluster of identities funded from correlated wallets within a short window must collectively post an umber-scaled bond that grows quadratically with cluster size. Honest agents wander freely with single small deposits but an attacker spawning 50 fakes from one source locks capital equal to fifty squared times the base stake before any reward unlocks. Replay checks confirm the trellis edges so splitting sources multiplies the entry cost rather than diluting it.
